questions.explanation: ȳ = (1/2)∫ y^2 dx / ∫ y dx = (1/2)*(1/3)/(1/3)? Wait ∫_0^1 x^2 dx=1/3, ∫ x^4 dx=1/5; ȳ=(1/2)*(1/5)/(1/3)=3/10=0.3. Let's set 0.3.
